blocks.text:
The model for a `DropDown` can be defined and filled
exactly as for a `ListView` or a `ColumnView`.
It must be a subclass of `Glib::Object`.
For instance, you might have a `DropDown` with one integer
and one text column, like so:
blocks.zh: `DropDown` 的模型可以按与 `ListView` 或 `ColumnView` 完全相同的方式定义和填充。它必须是 `Glib::Object` 的子类。比如你可以有一个 `DropDown`，其中包含一列整数和一列文本，如下所示：

blocks.text:
After appending rows to this model, you should provide the model to the
`DropDown` with the set_model() method.
Unless you use the `StringList` model, you also need to set
a `ListItemFactory` with set_factory().
If you want the items in the dropdown menu to look different from the item
in the `DropDown` widget, you also need to set a separate
`ListItemFactory` with set_list_factory().
blocks.zh: 向模型追加行之后，用 set_model() 方法把模型交给 `DropDown`。除非你用的是 `StringList` 模型，否则还需要用 set_factory() 设置一个 `ListItemFactory`。如果想让下拉菜单条目的外观与 `DropDown` 控件上显示的不同，还要用 set_list_factory() 另设一个 `ListItemFactory`。
